items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: I had some great players like Arnie Lawrence and on and on in my rehearsal band.

ctx.x: That’s great. Now you had a whole other part of your career in the educational field, of course with the arranging but also with Manhattan.

Yeah, I liked that. I started there in ‘70 and left in ‘80 because I became 62 and I was eligible for Social Security and I thought oh boy, this is going to be great you know. So I left the job and then I’ve regretted it many times. It had a lot of advantages. One of them was prior to that, prior to 1970 I used to have rehearsal bands because I liked to write and I had some great players like Arnie Lawrence and on and on in my rehearsal band. And I didn’t have that need because I had my own bands to play. And…
